prompt:
A photorealistic 3D architectural cutaway render of a single-storey house with the front wall removed, viewed straight on at eye level. Professional architectural visualisation quality, like a building-products catalogue render.

The cross-section exposes, from top to bottom as clearly separated layers:

ROOF — tiled or shingled roof covering over timber rafters and a visible truss structure, with battens and underlay visible at the cut edge.
CEILING — ceiling joists with fibreglass insulation batts laid between them, plasterboard ceiling below.
ROOM — a furnished open-plan living space. A fabric sofa and low timber coffee table on the left, a window in the left wall. On the right, a fitted kitchen: lower cabinets with a stone counter, a built-in oven with a dark glass door, an upper wall cabinet, a sink with a tap, and a tall stainless fridge at the far right end of the run.
WALLS — both left and right exterior walls cut open to show timber studs, insulation batts between them, the bottom plate at floor level, and the exterior cladding on the outside face.
FLOOR — timber floorboards.
SUBFLOOR — plywood or OSB sheeting over timber floor joists, with insulation batts between the joists.
CRAWLSPACE — an open void beneath, with concrete block piers supporting the floor structure, insulated flexible ductwork running through it, and a plastic vapour barrier laid over bare earth at the base.

MATERIALS: everything materially accurate and textured — real timber grain, fibreglass insulation with visible fibre, concrete aggregate in the piers, fabric weave on the sofa, brushed stainless on the appliances, stone counter surface. Natural material colours: warm timber, pink or yellow insulation, grey concrete, white plasterboard.

LIGHTING: soft, even, neutral studio lighting from the front. Gentle ambient occlusion in the recesses. No harsh shadows, no dramatic contrast, no coloured light. Everything clearly visible, nothing lost in shadow.

COMPOSITION: pure white background. The house fills the frame horizontally and is centred, roof near the top, crawlspace near the bottom. Square-on orthographic or near-orthographic projection so every layer reads as a clean horizontal band across the full width. No ground shadow. No landscaping, no sky, no surroundings.

NO text, NO labels, NO dimension lines, NO arrows, NO watermarks, NO people.

4:3 landscape, high resolution, sharp detail throughout.
